user.title: Choose location source
user.description: DWD Mobile automatically selects the nearest DWD weather station for this location and keeps all entity IDs stable when the station changes.

entity.title: Choose location entity
entity.description: Select an entity with latitude/longitude attributes, for example a device tracker, person or zone.

settings.title: DWD settings
settings.description: Hourly DWD updates can download a large amount of data. The normal mode is recommended.

data.sensor_forecast_steps: Hourly forecast steps in sensor attributes
data.max_station_distance_km: Maximum distance to nearest MOSMIX station (km)
data.last_known_location_max_age_min: Maximum age of last valid location (minutes)

data_description.enable_airquality: NO₂, ozone, PM2.5 and PM10 entities remain present even while the DWD upstream endpoint is unavailable. They automatically fill again if the endpoint returns.
data_description.station_hysteresis_km: 0 always selects the actual nearest station. A higher value avoids station flapping near station boundaries.
data_description.max_station_distance_km: Safety limit for very remote/offshore positions. MOSMIX stations are worldwide. 0 disables the distance limit.
data_description.last_known_location_max_age_min: During a GPS/entity outage, the last valid position is reused only for this long. 0 disables expiry. Default: 60 minutes.

error.no_coordinates: The selected entity does not provide usable coordinates
error.fixed_location_required: A location is required for fixed-location mode
